_doc: FLOIN Chennai — documented data portals that need a UI / registration / GIS-client step. Not auto-downloaded. Categories match data/vectors + data/rasters usage.

portals.name: CartoDEM 3m / 30m (ISRO-NRSC)
portals.why: India-specific DEM; free for Indian users; stereo-derived 3 m. Better surface fidelity than COP30 for flat urban Chennai.

portals.name: ALOS PALSAR RTC 12.5 m
portals.why: Finest freely available global DEM; also the InSAR source for subsidence.

portals.name: NASADEM HGT 30 m
portals.why: Void-filled SRTM: second independent check on COP30 vertical bias.

portals.name: TanDEM-X 90 m
portals.why: Independent global DEM to cross-validate terrain gradients.

portals.name: ICESat-2 ATL08 ground/canopy
portals.why: Vertical datum control points to remove DEM bias before depth modelling.

portals.name: SRTM 30 m (Bhuvan tiled)
portals.why: NRSC mirror of SRTM for offline/air-gapped use.

portals.name: Mapzen Terrarium elevation tiles
portals.why: 9 m z14 tiles for the 3D twin; already partly used in data/datasets/floodmap-net.

portals.name: IMD 0.25 deg gridded daily rainfall 1901-present
portals.why: THE authoritative Indian rainfall record. Replaces every synthetic rainfall value in the repo; basis for CN calibration and IDF curves.

portals.name: IMD 0.25 deg gridded daily temperature
portals.why: Evapotranspiration and antecedent moisture condition (AMC) class for SCS-CN.

portals.name: IMD AWS / ARG real-time stations
portals.why: Live station feed to replace the 8 hard-coded synthetic stations in rainfall_stations.geojson.

portals.name: IMDAA regional reanalysis 12 km hourly
portals.why: Hourly Indian reanalysis 1979-2019: ideal hindcast forcing for the Dec-2015 event.

portals.name: GPM IMERG Final Run 0.1 deg 30-min
portals.why: Satellite rainfall for ungauged sub-basins; sub-daily intensity for the time-stepped hydrograph.

portals.name: ERA5 / ERA5-Land hourly
portals.why: Antecedent soil moisture + evaporation forcing; independent of Open-Meteo.

portals.name: ISRIC SoilGrids 250 m (sand/silt/clay/BD/AWC)
portals.why: Derive real hydrologic soil group (A-D) and Green-Ampt parameters. Replaces the 3-polygon synthetic chennai_soil.geojson.

portals.name: NBSS&LUP soil map 1:50k (ICAR)
portals.why: The Indian national soil survey; the citation the repo already claims but does not actually contain.

portals.name: FAO Harmonized World Soil Database v1.2
portals.why: Global fallback soil units for areas NBSS does not cover.

portals.name: Bhuvan LULC 1:50k / 1:250k
portals.why: Indian national land-use/land-cover. Replaces the 5-rectangle synthetic chennai_lulc.geojson that currently sets the CN.

portals.name: Copernicus Global Land Cover 100 m
portals.why: Annual 2015-2019 LULC -> imperviousness trend between the 2015 and 2020 flood events.

portals.name: Dynamic World 10 m near-real-time LULC
portals.why: Per-event land cover at the exact flood date; captures new construction.

portals.name: JRC Global Surface Water 1984-2021
portals.why: Monthly water occurrence -> detects waterbodies LOST to encroachment, the #1 driver of worsening Chennai floods.

portals.name: OSM full extract (Geofabrik southern-zone)
portals.why: Real drains, waterways, culverts, buildings. Already present at data/raw/southern-zone-260731.osm.pbf (556 MB) but never extracted.

portals.name: Overpass API live OSM query
portals.why: Scriptable: waterway=drain/canal/river, man_made=culvert, bridge, embankment, lock_gate within the AOI.

portals.name: GCC Stormwater Drain network
portals.why: 23 MB real SWD geometry + 800+ ward-level PDF maps. Replaces the 5-line synthetic chennai_drainage.geojson entirely.

portals.name: Sentinel-1 GRD SAR flood mapping
portals.why: Radar flood extent for Dec-2015, Nov-2020 and Dec-2023. The single best independent validation target.

portals.name: Copernicus EMS Rapid Mapping activations
portals.why: Official delineation products for Indian flood activations.

portals.name: Global Flood Database (MODIS 2000-2018)
portals.why: 913 event maps including Chennai 2015 - ready-made flood-extent label set.

portals.name: Dartmouth Flood Observatory
portals.why: 1975-present flood catalogue + extents; long historical baseline.

portals.name: EM-DAT international disaster database
portals.why: Event-level economic loss and mortality to calibrate the loss function (currently hard-coded 420 Cr).

portals.name: UNOSAT satellite flood waters (Nov 2015)
portals.why: 64 MB shapefile of satellite-detected flood water - independent audit of GCC 2015 labels.

portals.name: India Flood Inventory / NDMA flood atlas
portals.why: National flood inventory 1985-2016 and state flood atlases.

portals.name: INCOIS storm surge + tide forecast
portals.why: Real tide tables and surge envelopes for the Ennore / Marina downstream boundary condition.

portals.name: Copernicus Marine sea level / surge reanalysis
portals.why: Hourly sea level at the Chennai coast - controls how fast Adyar/Cooum can drain.

portals.name: NOAA Tides & Currents harmonic constituents
portals.why: Harmonic constituents to synthesise any tide for the Bay of Bengal.

portals.name: India-WRIS reservoir + river gauge telemetry
portals.why: Live Chembarambakkam / Poondi levels and Adyar gauge. The hard-coded '4,500 cusecs' outflow in chennai-data.ts should come from here.

portals.name: CWC flood forecasting network
portals.why: Official level/flow forecasts - benchmark for the FLOIN forecast horizon.

portals.name: CGWB groundwater levels + aquifer maps
portals.why: Depth-to-water-table controls infiltration capacity and baseflow in SCS-CN.

portals.name: India-WRIS groundwater telemetry
portals.why: Live piezometer readings to replace the synthetic chennai_borewells stub.

portals.name: COMET-LiCSAR InSAR deformation
portals.why: Chennai land subsidence rate - explains why identical rainfall floods deeper over time.

portals.name: GHSL built-up surface + population 1975-2030
portals.why: Urban growth timeline; quantifies the imperviousness increase that made 2015 worse than 2005 and 2023 worse than 2015.

portals.name: WorldPop constrained 100 m population
portals.why: Real dasymetric exposure per 100 m cell. Replaces the 8 hard-coded ward population constants used by wardDamage().

portals.name: Census of India 2011 ward tables
portals.publisher: Office of the Registrar General, India
portals.why: Authoritative ward population / households / literacy for vulnerability weighting.

portals.name: Google Open Buildings 2.5D temporal
portals.why: Building footprints WITH height -> real depth-damage curves instead of the synthetic building_heights stub.

portals.name: Microsoft Global Building Footprints
portals.why: Near-complete footprint coverage; OSM in Chennai is only ~1,811 buildings, far too sparse.

portals.name: OSM Overpass - hospitals/schools/power/shelters
portals.why: Real critical-infrastructure geometry for evacuation routing, replacing ~90 synthetic point stubs.

portals.name: GCC flood and rain relief centres 2024
portals.why: Official shelter list for evac capacity in the 05 Evacuation module.

portals.name: NASA NEX-GDDP-CMIP6 0.25 deg
portals.why: Downscaled CMIP6 for design storms and IDF-curve shift under warming.

portals.name: WorldClim 2.1 + CMIP6
portals.why: Baseline climatology for design-rainfall scaling.

portals.name: IPCC AR6 Interactive Atlas - India
portals.why: Regional extreme-rainfall projections to justify the Climate Extreme scenario category.

portals.name: GCC ward boundaries + 2022 delimitation
portals.why: Authoritative ward polygons; the repo's chennai_wards_200 is the pre-delimitation 200-ward set.

portals.name: TNSDMA hazard / vulnerability atlas
portals.publisher: Tamil Nadu State Disaster Management Authority
portals.why: State-level hazard, vulnerability and risk layers - the official counterpart to the composite risk score.

portals.name: CMDA boundary + Chennai Master Plan 2026
portals.why: Planning boundary and macro-drainage / soil / disaster-management plan maps.

portals.name: Sentinel-2 L2A 10 m
portals.why: Post-event water delineation by NDWI/MNDWI to build more flood labels.

portals.name: Google Earth Engine public data catalog
portals.why: Server-side access to JRC GSW, ESA WorldCover, SRTM, CHIRPS, IMERG and Sentinel-1 - no large downloads needed.

portals.name: Esri Living Atlas of the World
portals.why: Ready-made imagery, elevation and flood layers for the ArcGIS Pro / ArcGIS Online workflow.

portals.name: ISRO Bhoonidhi (Cartosat / RISAT SAR)
portals.why: Indian high-resolution optical and SAR imagery; free for Indian government/academic users.

portals.name: QGIS hydrology stack (WhiteboxTools, SAGA, GRASS, PCRaster)
portals.why: Fill sinks, D8/D-infinity, TWI, HAND and SCS-CN inside the existing data/qgis/*.qgz projects.

portals.name: QGIS QuickMapServices / XYZ tiles
portals.why: Basemaps for visual QA of the collected layers against satellite imagery.

portals.name: HEC-RAS 2D + HEC-HMS
portals.why: Authoritative hydraulic solver to benchmark the browser shallow-water engine.

portals.name: ArcGIS Hydro / ArcGIS Pro flood tooling
portals.why: ArcHydro, HEC-GeoRAS and Flood Awareness workflows for the ArcGIS-side processing.

portals.name: UNOSAT satellite flood waters, Chennai Dec 2015 (S1 12/24-Nov + S1/L8 pre-flood baselines)
portals.why: Independent satellite flood extent; parsed stdlib-only into data/vectors/fl20151123ind_shp_*.geojson and promoted to public/.

portals.name: JRC Global Surface Water v1.4 (occurrence / seasonality / transitions)
portals.why: 1984-2021 surface-water history; third opinion on permanent water for the flood-minus-baseline method. Tile for Chennai: occurrence 10N-080E.
